data.exact_reserve_text: The return on capacity for the 2012 closed year of account at 31 December 2014 is shown below together with forecasts for the two open years of account. ... 2012 YOA Closed ... Result/forecast (GBP '000) (8,210).

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate was impacted by Hurricane Odile which occurred in September 2014 and damaged a port in Mexico. The current gross outstanding is GBP 3.2m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of reserves for prior years, primarily driven by a loss of GBP 8.210m on the 2012 closed year of account. This adverse development represents 19.23% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The report also mentions Hurricane Odile in September 2014, which impacted the syndicate's current year claims.
raw_causal_phrases: loss of GBP 8,210 attributable to the 2012 year of account

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property
